items.name: theme
items.title: Terminal Theme
items.description: The tokens, typography, motion and CRT effects used by every component.

theme.background-image-beam: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 44%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--phosphor) 16%, transparent) 50%, transparent 56%)
theme.shadow-glow-strong: 0 0 34px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--phosphor) 40%, transparent), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--phosphor) 20%, transparent)
theme.shadow-signal-control: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12), 0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--signal) 12%, transparent)

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open one at a time or many. The marker is a plus that rotates into a minus.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A notice with a lit left edge and a matching icon. Four tones.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A pink confirmation dialog for destructive or irreversible actions.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Initials in mono inside a bordered square.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A bordered rectangle of tracked-out mono for a status or a count. Eight variants.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A path in mono, separated by slashes, with the current segment in white.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Seven variants and five sizes in uppercase mono. `primary` is filled phosphor; `signal` marks urgent states.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A panel with a coloured left edge. One `accent` property drives both the edge and the title.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: `[ ]` and `[x]`. A square that fills with the beam when it is on.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: The accordion without the styling, for when you have drawn the trigger yourself.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A search line and a list that narrows as you type. Groups, shortcuts, and a dialog wrapper.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Opens in four steps rather than on a curve, with one pass of the beam down the panel.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, and shortcut hints in the same mono as the keys.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A dashed hairline box for a list with nothing in it.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A hairline field in mono with a phosphor caret. Focus brightens the border instead of adding a ring.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One cell per character, with a drawn caret in the active one.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key with two pixels of implied depth under it. Pass `glyph` for `⌘`, `⇧` and `↵`.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A field's name, set as an eyebrow. Small, tracked out, phosphor.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page numbers as joined cells, so a run of them reads as one control.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A bordered panel anchored to its trigger.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Three pixels of track and a light in it. Pass `indeterminate` for a segment that sweeps and leaves.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Terminal-style radio marks in their unchecked and checked states: `( )` and `(•)`.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels split by a hairline that lights when you take hold of it.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A hairline track and a square thumb, in place of the operating system's own.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A trigger that reads as a field, and a list whose chosen row carries a lit left edge.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: One pixel of the border colour, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A drawer from any of the four edges. The edge it slides from keeps a lit border.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder rows in dim phosphor.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A hairline track, a lit range, and a square handle. Single value or range.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A lit pixel travelling a 3x3 grid, four brightness levels trailing behind it.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A squared-off rocker in two sizes.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A manifest in mono with hairline rules. `is-numeric` gives a cell amber tabular figures.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Two variants: joined segments and a quieter line.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multiline field that grows with its content.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Sonner styled with the Afterglow palette.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays down.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggles joined the way the segmented tabs are.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A compact label with one lit edge and no arrow.

items.name: alarm-button
items.title: Alarm Button
items.description: Two flashes and a rest, the way a warning lamp blinks. Pointing at it stops the flashing.

items.name: boot-log
items.title: Boot Log
items.description: A self test that prints itself line by line, at its final height from the first frame.

items.name: caret
items.title: Caret
items.description: A blinking block that follows the surrounding font size.

items.name: connector
items.title: Connector
items.description: A rule extending left or right from a heading.

items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow
items.description: The tracked-out line above a heading, with an optional block caret.

items.name: led
items.title: LED
items.description: A status lamp and the line it sits in. Four tones, and the idle one holds still.

items.name: prompt
items.title: Prompt
items.description: A shell line. Sigil, field and caret share one row with no border between them.

items.name: scanlines
items.title: Scanlines
items.description: The glass. Two densities, an optional vignette, and a multiply blend.

items.name: screen
items.title: Screen
items.description: A framed CRT surface with scanlines and curved-screen falloff.

items.name: shell
items.title: Shell
items.description: A command transcript and prompt with command history. Bring the commands and their effects.

items.name: terminal-window
items.title: Terminal Window
items.description: Window chrome in three conventions: macOS, Windows, or a slim hairline version. Resizable and collapsible.

items.name: operator-dashboard
items.title: Operator Dashboard
items.description: A full-page operations dashboard with boot status, volume health, rebuild progress and a shell.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal Preset
items.description: The shared theme and every registry component in one `shadcn init` preset.
